resources.string: Signed out — your account was opened on another device (e.g. the Zeekr app). Sign in again to reconnect.
Session expired — please sign in again.
Tap the pencil to name your car
Accepting adds it to your garage so you can see status and control it. The offline Bluetooth key is set up separately from the Key tab.

OpenZeekr is a free, non-commercial passion project — not affiliated with Zeekr. Yes, a lot of it is vibe-coded, but it also took a solid week of sleepless nights to make your key connect and unlock cleanly.\n\nIf it\'s useful to you, a small tip keeps development going. Totally optional — either way, enjoy the app. 💚
This sets up OpenZeekr for your own Zeekr vehicle in three quick steps:
Sign in with your Zeekr account to reach the cloud and your vehicle.
Provision this phone as its own BLE key to lock/unlock at the car. You can skip and do it later.
Control the car from the cloud, and over Bluetooth once the key is set up.
Authorized use only — for a vehicle you own or are permitted to access.
Pick the market your car and account belong to. This selects the right Zeekr servers. Each region also needs its OWN extracted keys (zeekr_key_extractor --region %1$s) — you\'ll add them next.

⚠️ This region is reconstructed from the stock app\'s host tables and has not been verified against a real car. Login and the digital key may need a host corrected later under Settings › Region › Advanced.
This build ships with no keys. Paste your own extracted zeekr_secrets.json to reach the cloud. Nothing is sent anywhere — it\'s stored encrypted on this device.
Login failed? Tap to send us an encrypted diagnostic log (email it to the developer).
Provision this phone as its own Bluetooth key so it can lock and unlock the car up close — even offline. This is optional; you can skip and set it up later from the Key tab.
Then tap Finish (Skip to do it later).
Bluetooth permission denied — enable it in system settings
Offline lock / unlock at the car
This account owns the car — an owner key will be created.
Shared account — using a key the owner has shared with you.
Unlock as you near the car, lock when you leave.
✓ Calibrated at your car · door %1$d dBm · 6 m %2$d dBm
Connecting to the car — try Calibrate again once linked
Calibration cleared — approach unlock turned off
Approach unlock needs a one-time calibration walk at your car (~2 min). Until then it stays off.
Unlock as you walk up to the car
Lock the car as you leave
Sensitivity - how close before it unlocks
Unlocks within arm\'s reach · most secure
Unlocks about halfway · locks as you walk away
Runs a low-power scan, then connects & unlocks over the BLE key. Uses a foreground service - allow unrestricted background for reliability.
Double-press volume up to unlock the car, volume down to lock it - from the lock screen.
Needs a secure screen lock (PIN, pattern or password). Set one in system settings to use this.
For ~4 s after the screen turns on while locked, a double-press of volume up unlocks (or volume down locks) the car over the BLE key - without unlocking the phone.

Anyone who is holding this phone while it is locked, and who knows the gesture (double-press volume up to unlock, volume down to lock), can control the car WITHOUT unlocking the phone.\n\nThe window is only open for about 4 seconds each time the screen turns on while locked, and it closes the moment you unlock the phone or the screen turns off. Only enable this if you accept that trade-off.
Enabled - double-press volume up to unlock, down to lock
This forgets the key on this phone. You can re-provision it later from your account.

Walk to 4 spots around your car once. We measure this phone\'s real signal at the door and at ~6 m and use those as your unlock / walk-away thresholds — so approach-unlock works for YOUR phone and car, not a generic guess. Carry the phone the way you normally do.
Stay near the car for the whole walk and keep the area clear of other people.
Car unlocks as you walk up
Car locks itself as you leave
Tap Refresh to fetch the latest status from the cloud.
Calibrate at your car (Key tab) to enable
Unlock at ≥ %1$d dBm · auto-lock at ≤ %2$d dBm
Precondition the pack — run before charging
Restricted access for a guest / valet
Send-to-car isn\'t a button — OpenZeekr registers as a share target, so a pin dropped in Maps goes straight to the car\'s nav.
Couldn\'t get a location fix - check location permission and that location is on.
Location permission is needed to add an exclusion zone.
Auto-enable Sentry when the car locks
Arms Sentry on walk-away (and manual) lock. Skipped inside your exclusion zones below.
None yet. Add your home or other trusted spots so Sentry isn\'t armed there.
None yet. Add your home so the car isn\'t auto-locked or unlocked (and doesn\'t keep chirping) while parked there.
Pan the map so the pin is on the spot - the circle is the zone.
Cloud footage via sentinel-monitoring-service. Live view needs the RTC provider SDK (not identified yet).
Fires all park/move opcodes once, ignoring the car\'s gate. Only run with clear space around the car — if the car accepts an autonomous command it can move.
Press and hold; release stops instantly (the car halts the moment the 500 ms heartbeat drops).
Tap the add-person icon to share this car by email. Anyone you share with shows up here and you can revoke their access.
End %1$s\'s access to the car? They\'ll need a new invite to use it again.
Enter the email of the person to share with. They\'ll get an invite in their Zeekr app to accept.
OpenZeekr encrypted debug log attached (readable only by the developers).
Encrypted log ready to send - pick your email app.
Check the cloud for a new software version for your car.
Est. install time once downloaded: ~%1$d min
Keep the car parked - it\'s installing and will be unavailable briefly.
You can install it now or pick a different time.
I understand that installing now takes the car offline for about %1$d min, and it should be parked.

Developer tool. This ABORTS the update assignment on the cloud to clear a stuck install - it does not finish the update. Only use it if the car has actually completed the update but the app is frozen (e.g. stuck at a percentage) and remote control is blocked.
Alerts from your car — charging, security, parking — will show up here.
Couldn\'t load more — tap to retry
Couldn\'t load trips to export - tap Reload, then try again
Exported %1$d trips; some pages couldn\'t load - retry for the rest
Lets the car log your drives so they appear here.
On - the car is logging your drives.
Off - turn on to start logging drives here.
Your recent drives — distance, energy and duration — will show up here.
A daily off-peak charge window — the car charges inside these times.
Charging will continue if the limit isn\'t reached at the end time.
Have the cabin (and battery) preconditioned by your departure time on the days you pick.

Schedules are stored on the car (via ms-charge-manage), so the car must be AWAKE to save them. If it\'s been parked a while it may be asleep — wake it (unlock it, open the Zeekr app, or plug in to charge), then save. A save is only confirmed once the car acknowledges it.
Repeat on (pick at least one day)
Sign in to control your car over the cloud
Found %1$d pending invitation(s) - see the prompt.
Logs digital-key / proximity BLE traffic (key material).
Ping OK - the car replied (command link alive).
Ping: no reply - not connected, or the link is wedged (connect on the Key tab and retry).

CCC pairing code: %1$s
(BT,NFC wallet URL copied - open on an iPhone)

BT,NFC: %2$s

UWB probe: %3$s
%1$d more taps to enable developer mode
Update %1$s is available - see the About section.
You are on the latest version.
OpenZeekr is an independent clean-room research app for your own Zeekr. Not affiliated with Zeekr, Geely or ECARX. MIT licensed.
Thanks to the community that mapped the cloud first: Wysie, Fryyyyy, mescon.
This wipes your account (email, password, tokens, VIN) AND your digital key from this phone, and revokes the key with the car. You\'ll need to log in and re-provision to use it again.

Debug logging writes detailed diagnostics to the on-device log - and that log will contain SENSITIVE DATA: your digital-key material, session tokens, VIN, device IDs and location. Anything with access to the app\'s logs could read it and potentially unlock or track your car. (Your account password is NOT logged.)\n\nOnly turn this on if you\'re helping debug an issue, and turn it back off - and clear the log - when you\'re done. Are you sure you want to continue?

Which regional Zeekr backend to use. Each region has its own servers AND its own six secrets — switching region does not change your keys, so provide the keys extracted for that region (zeekr_key_extractor --region %1$s).
⚠️ Reconstructed from the stock host tables — not verified on a real car. If login or the digital key fail, a host may be wrong for your market; correct it under Advanced.
Re-selecting a region above resets all of these to that region\'s defaults.
Your own extracted keys — stored encrypted on-device.
Error: both overseas keys must be set
Copied to clipboard - it contains your password, tokens and keys, so paste it somewhere safe.
This log is too long to copy - use \"Share\" to send it as a file.
Copied, but this log is long - the clipboard/paste may cut it off and make it unreadable. Prefer \"Share (encrypted)\" to send it as a file.
Copied - encrypted; only the developers can read it.
\"Share (encrypted)\" sends the log as a file only the developers can read - the best way to report a bug.
